messages:
sam: quick sync on dashboard cards when viewport narrows. current behavior stacks cards vertically which pushes the most important cards far down. proposing a prioritized single-column with 'pin' affordance for the top card.

rita: agree; on phones users expect the top card to be the one they interact with most. what about a sticky header that shows pinned card summary?

jon: sticky header could work but watch performance during scroll on older android webviews. simpler: collapse less-important cards into an accordion called 'More metrics'.

harpreet: accessibility concern: accordions need to be keyboard accessible and announce expanded state. also ensure the sticky header doesn't trap focus. ux-bot: automated check: recommended aria-controls and aria-expanded on toggle, and ensure heading levels don't jump.

sam: good catches. copy Q: label the toggle "More metrics" or "Other cards"? shorter is better on mobile.

rita: "More" might be ambiguous. "More metrics" explicit but longer. lean "More metrics" and show a tooltip on long-press for extra context.

jon: layout nits — when cards collapse into accordion, we should preserve chart aspect ratios so numbers don't reflow. use a 4:3 min aspect ratio and allow overflow-y in the collapsed panel.

harpreet: another nit: when pinned card is present and user opens a modal from that card, ensure backdrop doesn't hide the sticky summary. test with voiceover.

sam: implementation plan: (1) add pin state to card model, (2) show pinned summary in sticky strip at top on widths <480px, (3) remaining cards become a single accordion group called "More metrics", (4) ensure aria attrs and 48px targets.

rita: breakpoint suggestion: trigger collapse at 520px for large phones and 360px for small. let's run with 520 and test.

jon: dev note: CSS stub: `@media (max-width:520px){ .cards-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .card{min-height:120px;} }` will prototype.

harpreet: a11y test volunteers? i'll pair with rita Friday 11am PST. ux-bot: checklist appended: [ ] aria-expanded, [ ] role=region on panels, [ ] focus order from top to accordion content, [ ] contrast for sticky strip >=4.5:1.

sam: awesome. i'll update figma and post a lightweight prototype link. thanks all :raised_hands:
